from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """A company's total liabilities from one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The securities/trading code")
    liabilities_total: float | None = Field(description="Total liabilities amount (负债合计)")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元'")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    report_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period, e.g. '2024年3月31日'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liability_records: list[CompanyLiabilityRecord]
